The Serta advantage

Comfortable, supportive, and cooling sleep

Zoned comfort

Designed for full-body alignment throughout the night, providing support where the body naturally curves, ensuring comfort where the body touches the bed the most.

Pressure relief

Contouring foams and coils respond to movement throughout the night, cradling your body while reducing pressure, as well as minimizing the impact of your partner’s movement.

Cooling comfort

Our cool-to-the-touch fabrics, breathable foams and cooling technologies promote airflow and help with temperature regulation as you sleep.
